endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mn_dnr_phelps_mill_carry_in_access_20260918 mn-dnr-water-access-sites-objectid-2258-was00559: Minnesota DNR's Water Access Sites feature 2258 / WAS00559 identifies Phelps Mill Public Water Access Site, administered by Otter Tail County, as Carry-In with a Natural surface and publishes GPS geometry at 46.3821666505,-95.8210176143. The DNR Otter Tail River water-trail guide identifies the Phelps Mill County Park carry-in access at about river mile 85 and directs paddlers to portage across the park lawn and launch west of the parking area. The existing coordinate matches the state GPS feature; keep it as the public access-area anchor, not a survey of the exact wet toe. Otter Tail County says there is no conventional boat-launch facility, consistent with hand-carry access rather than a trailer ramp.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mn_dnr_phelps_mill_carry_in_access_20260918 mn-dnr-water-access-sites-objectid-2258-was00559) on Otter Tail River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
